name: Purple Insect 27
author: aadium
description: Green button that scales up on hover with a smooth transition.
howItWorks: On hover, transform becomes scale(1.5), transform becomes rotate(45deg) scale(1.2).
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Purple Insect 27</title>
<style>
/* Purple Insect 27 by aadium — https://uiverse.io/aadium/purple-insect-27 */
.morph-button {
  display: relative;
  background-color: #66DA43;
  color: #66DA43;
  width: 85px;
  height: 40px;
  border: 2px solid transparent;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.3s ease-in-out;
}

.morph-button:hover {
  transform: scale(1.5);
}

.morph-button:active {
  transform: scale(0.8);
  background-color: #212121;
  border: 2px solid #66DA43;
}

.morph-button:before {
  content: "Twist";
  display: block;
  position: absolute;
  margin-top: -22px;
  margin-left: -2px;
  padding: 12px 25px;
  transform-origin: center;
  transition: transform 0.3s ease-in-out;
  z-index: 1;
  background-color: #212121;
  border: 2px solid #66DA43;
}

.morph-button:hover:before {
  transform: rotate(45deg) scale(1.2);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="morph-button"></button>

</body>
</html>
